proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the disc label side and confirm the disc is included in the case.
Send a short video of the disc being inserted on a PS4 and the game loading to the main menu.
Send photos of the inside inserts/pads/manual (everything that comes with it) and the receipt if available.
Send close-up photos of the case/spine/edges for any cracks, fading, or stickers.
Send photos showing region/compatibility details (back cover or disc label).
response.reason: The witness can confirm only that it is a PS4 Watch Dogs: Legion case; disc inclusion, condition, originality, and completeness are not proven. So it can be priced at the worst case (disc/working/complete set unknown) while requesting the missing proof to raise value.
